dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - May 23, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
"Cardinals Cruise, Astros Shut Down Cubs in Dominant Performances"

The St. Louis Cardinals took down the Cincinnati Reds 8-1 and 6-7, with Jordan Walker making a significant impact in both games. In game one, Walker hit a home run and drove in three runs, while in game two, he went 3-for-4 with a home run and four RBIs. The Astros also had a strong performance, with Christian Walker hitting two home runs and driving in three runs in a 3-0 win over the Cubs.

On the pitching side, the Cardinals' staff effort was a key factor in both wins, with Andre Pallante earning the win in game one. The Astros' Kai-Wei Teng was dominant on the mound, throwing six scoreless innings and striking out six in the win over the Cubs.
